page.layout: One printed page. Running head at top centre with page number 379 at top right. Below it, a column heading line, then one table of 32 rows in four columns (Anni Iuliani, An. aetat. Aug., An. Olymp., An. Vrb. cond.), separated by printed leader rules. A marginal note sits at the left beside the second group of rows. No text below the table.
page.notes: The printed leader rules between the columns are typographical dashes and are not transcribed. The first column reads 8 to 1 and then 1 to 24; the second group is labelled by the marginal note "Anni ord. Iul." The Olympiad and Urbis conditae figures are printed in old-style numerals and were read as Arabic numerals. No doubtful readings.
